title: iPhone or iPad says Software Update Failed
applies_to: Wireless iOS and iPadOS updates. The supported OS version depends on the device model.
summary: Check compatibility, free space and network access before retrying. Note whether the failure happens while checking, downloading or installing.
steps: Confirm that the target version supports your device. Check available space under Settings, General, then iPhone Storage or iPad Storage.
Connect to power and a reliable Wi-Fi network. If the download is slow, pause other large downloads.
For an update-server or verification error, retry on a different Wi-Fi network. If the wireless attempt still fails, use the computer-based update procedure linked in Apple’s guide.
evidence_notes: The forum report describes an update that stalled at the request stage. A reply suggested Wi-Fi, but the original poster did not confirm that it fixed the issue.
